definitions.explanation: Describes being completely exhausted, having no energy left.

examples.japanese: へとへと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{動|うご}けない→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: I'm so tired I can't move.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一日|いちにち}{中|じゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧⟦{働|はたら}いて→働く：00503_hataraku⟧へとへと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I worked all day and got exhausted.

notes:
へとへと is a mimetic word (⟦オノマトペ→オノマトペ：22607_onomatope⟧) describing extreme physical exhaustion — being completely drained of energy.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Functions as both a na-adjective and adverb.
- Predicate: へとへと⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧/⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧ (I'm exhausted)
- Adverbial: へとへと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{疲|つか}れる→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧ (to get dead tired)
- へとへと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become exhausted
- へとへと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{疲|つか}れる→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧: to get dead tired
- へとへと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧〜⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: too tired to do ~
- ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧へとへと⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧: I'm completely wiped out

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦くたくた→くたくた：05169_kutakuta⟧: worn out (similar level, slightly less dramatic)
- ⟦ぐったり→ぐったり：05835_guttari⟧: limp, collapsed (emphasizes physical collapse)
- ⟦ばてる→ばてる：09303_bateru⟧: to be worn out (verb form)
- ⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧: tired (general — へとへと is much stronger)

REGISTER:
Casual and conversational. Not used in formal writing.
